response_definition: post-treatment model-scale expression minus its supplied paired-control expression

selection.profile_rule: Sort alias-exclusion-group representatives by casefolded source drug name and pert_id; select 10 evenly spaced group ranks. Representative: first name/pert_id, lowest dose, then time, RNA plate and source profile ID.
selection.gene_rule: Top 12 genes by mean absolute observed response across all 661 treatments; ties by gene ID. Descriptive display selection, not evaluation evidence.
